name: cs-worktree
description: Git worktree launcher for CS workflows — /cs-start creates an isolated worktree + branch for a target project and records a manifest so cs-end can later merge it back to the base branch. Pairs with cs-end --merge-worktree. Non-destructive by default: never force-pushes, never auto-resolves conflicts.
